hotels.title: UK Stylish Leeds Contemporary Retreat within City Centre
hotels.description: Discover how Leeds reinvented itself from an industrial town to a vibrant, cosmopolitan city with an escape to Crowne Plaza Leeds, an IHG Hotel. Perfectly positioned in the city centre, spring into this confident Yorkshire city in search of lively nightlife, contemporary art at The Tetley and indulgent shopping. Once you return, feast on a selection of delicious plates with a Yorkshire twist at LS1 restaurant or visit the expansive Spirit Health Club and enjoy a restorative soak in the indoor pool.

hotels.vendor_name: Oulton Hall Hotel, Spa & Golf Resort
hotels.title: Historic Yorkshire Spa & Golf Escape with 27-Hole Course
hotels.description: Revel in the exceptional beauty of Yorkshire with a one-of-a-kind stay at Oulton Hall Hotel, Spa & Golf Resort - housed within an 18th-century mansion. Set just a short distance from Leeds, this luxury resort places you within close reach of the city while offering laidback country ambience. Enthusiastic golfers can tee off at the resort’s 27-hole course where curving fairways and immaculate greens offer the perfect challenge for all levels, and The Claret Jug clubhouse is the place to refuel and celebrate after the last hole. Away from the green, the indoor heated pool, health club and spa offer an oasis of calm to ensure a blissful escape. The Calverley Grill is the place to go for mouthwatering fare, and when you need to toast those extra special moments, take a seat at the Champagne Bar and choose from over 50 international sparkling varieties.
